title: Rigid cellular plastics, determination of compression properties

inputs.note: Procedure A: relative deformation is the platens' travel over the initial thickness h0.

conditioning.note: Deformation is counted from where the steepest straight part meets zero force (9.2.2). The standard's fallback for a curve without one (the deformation at 250 Pa) is not implemented: such a curve is flagged.

width.note: The steepest straight part is sought over stretches of this much strain (the standard asks for the most linear, steepest part). TenForge's choice; ISO 844:2021 to be checked for a rule of its own.

rounding.note: Reporting step. TenForge's choice; ISO 844:2021 to be checked for a rule of its own.

strain.note: The compressive strength is a maximum reached before 10 % relative deformation. From the publisher's public preview of ISO 844:2021 (https://cdn.standards.iteh.ai/samples/73560/24ff667df32b4981b29aa870b385bba2/ISO-844-2021.pdf); to be confirmed from the purchased text.

min_drop.note: A maximum counts if the stress at 10 % is at least this fraction below it. TenForge's choice; ISO 844:2021 to be checked for a rule of its own.
